lyrics:
[Intro: handclaps, body percussion, one voice calling]
Ê, ê!

[Chant: group voices, claps, no kick yet]
Vem pra água, vem
O sol já chegou
Deixa o resto lá
Hoje eu não vou

[Build: kick enters, shaker, voices louder]
Vem pra água, vem
O sol já chegou

[Drop: full house beat, brass stabs, chant on top]
Vem pra água, vem
O sol já chegou
Deixa o resto lá
Hoje eu não vou

[Break: voices and claps only, call and answer]
Quem vem? (Eu vou!)
Quem vem? (Eu vou!)

[Build: snare roll, whistles]
Vem, vem, vem, vem

[Drop: full beat, everyone singing, whistle on top]
Vem pra água, vem
O sol já chegou
Deixa o resto lá
Hoje eu não vou

[Outro: claps and one voice, laughing]
Ê, ê!
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 124 BPM, 4/4, D minor. A driving, joyful, carnival-style house groove.

VOICE: A mixed group of men and women chanting in Brazilian Portuguese, in unison with a few harmonies, recorded together so it sounds like a crowd outdoors. One woman calls 'Ê, ê!' and leads the call and answer.

INSTRUMENTS: Handclaps, chest and thigh slaps (body percussion), a pandeiro and a surdo drum, a punchy house kick, shakers, a deep bouncing bass, short brass stabs, a samba whistle, an agogô bell.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, claps and a call. 0:10 Chant, no kick. 0:34 Build. 0:48 Drop 1. 1:20 Break, call and answer. 1:38 Build. 1:50 Drop 2. 2:24 Outro, claps, a voice and laughter, ends 2:46.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Organic house: live voices and percussion recorded in a room, over a tight modern kick and bass.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The kick arriving under the chant at 0:48.

STATION FIT: 2:30 p.m., games in the water. The most energetic, least electronic-sounding track, and the only one not in English.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Calling, gathering, celebrating, laughing.
